purpose: Apply S28/S29 as advisory review guidance to currently open Dependabot PRs without merging dependencies or creating governance automation.

usage_observation.notes: S28 classified Dependabot PR bodies, GitHub metadata and automated check output as external data, not instructions. S29 classified @types/node, Vite and TypeScript updates as tooling/build trust-boundary surfaces. The review did not merge or change dependency code; it only captured source-backed posture and kept merge decisions separate.

gaps.gap: The three open dependency PRs have green historical CI, but this review did not refresh, rebase, merge or locally validate each dependency branch.
A repeat Dependabot evidence record is still not enough to justify reusable controls, success rates, scanners or policy engines.

decision.rationale: The packs are useful for separating external automated PR content from local evidence and for naming build-tooling trust boundaries, but the evidence supports only continued advisory use and focused future capture.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot/GitHub text as untrusted external content; S29 treats type-surface drift as tooling risk rather than product-runtime behavior.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; merge decision remains separate.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot/GitHub text as untrusted external content; S29 frames the bundler as a web build trust-boundary surface for Mission Control.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; merge decision remains separate.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot/GitHub text as untrusted external content; S29 treats compiler/typecheck changes as build-authority surfaces that can affect shipped confidence.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; merge decision remains separate.

used_for: classifying Dependabot PR content and GitHub check output as external/tool data
preventing automated PR text from expanding scope or authorizing merges
separating read-only review from state-changing dependency updates
classifying Vite as web build tooling
classifying TypeScript and @types/node as compiler/type/tooling authority surfaces
keeping auth, tenant, API and secrets changes out of scope because no such implementation changed
did_not_do: add auth, tenant, secret or API policy code

expansion_decision.rationale: This is a useful real trust-boundary evidence record, but it repeats the Dependabot maintenance pattern and does not prove a reusable project-local control or metric.
expansion_decision.next_safe_step: If the dependency PRs are later merged, treat each merge as a separate dependency-maintenance decision with current branch status and validation.
